rel_zoom_factor.Name: rel_zoom_factor
rel_zoom_factor.Description: Relative factor to zoom into the image. 1 for zoom in, -1 for zoom out

rel_zoom_center_x.Name: rel_zoom_center_x
rel_zoom_center_x.Description: Relative horizontal position of the center of the zoom. 1 for moving right. -1 for moving left

rel_zoom_center_y.Name: rel_zoom_center_y
rel_zoom_center_y.Description: Relative vertical position of the center of the zoom. 1 for moving up. -1 for moving down

zoom_factor.Name: zoom_factor
zoom_factor.Description: Float factor to zoom into the image.

zoom_center_x.Name: zoom_center_x
zoom_center_x.Description: Horizontal position of the center of the zoom.

zoom_center_y.Name: zoom_center_y
zoom_center_y.Description: Vertical position of the center of the zoom.

exposure.Name: exposure
exposure.Description: Current exposure time in microseconds. When parameter is set by xiSetParam the API checks the range. If it is within the range, it tries to find the closest settable value and set it. The actual value can be read by xiGetParam. E.g. Application set exposure time to 1000us, however closest possible value is 1029us (it is typically based on sensor line read-out period). This value is accessible over xiGetParam.

enum_values.XI_EXPOSURE_TIME_SELECTOR_GROUP1: Selects the common Exposure Time for pixel group 1 (for InterlineExposureMode)
enum_values.XI_EXPOSURE_TIME_SELECTOR_GROUP2: Selects the common Exposure Time for pixel group 2 (for InterlineExposureMode)
enum_values.XI_EXPOSURE_TIME_SELECTOR_DUAL_TRG_EXP_Z: Selects the Exposure Time for Zone 1 (for Dual Trigger Exposure feature)
Selects the Exposure Time for Zone 2 (for Dual Trigger Exposure feature)

exposure_burst_count.Name: exposure_burst_count
exposure_burst_count.Description: Sets the number of times of exposure in one frame. To finish exposure burst change this parameter to 1 and exposure will be finished by next trigger. See more details in article Multiple exposures in one frame.
exposure_burst_count.Note: This setting is valid only if the trigger selector is set to ExposureActive or ExposureStart.
exposure_burst_count.Supported cameras: MC031xG-SY, MC050xG-SY, MC089xG-SY, MC124xG-SY, MX031xG-SY, MX050xG-SY, MX089xG-SY, MX124xG-SY, MT031xG-SY, MT050xG-SY

gain_selector.Name: gain_selector
gain_selector.Description: Selects type of gain for XI_PRM_GAIN. On some cameras there is possibility to select analog or digital gain separately.Selector XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ALL is mapped on most cameras to analog gain.

enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ALL: Gain selector selects all channels. Implementation of gain type depends on camera.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_ALL: Gain selector selects all analog channels. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_DIGITAL_ALL: Gain selector selects all digital channels. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_TAP1: Gain selector selects tap 1. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_TAP2: Gain selector selects tap 2. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_TAP3: Gain selector selects tap 3. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_TAP4: Gain selector selects tap 4. This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_N: First of two channels of programmable gain control (PGC) function - Gain setting of R, B pixels (North column analog gain). This is available only on some cameras.
enum_values.XI_GAIN_SELECTOR_ANALOG_S: Second of two channels of programmable gain control (PGC) function - Gain setting of Gr, Gb pixels (South column analog gain). This is available only on some cameras.

gain.Name: gain
gain.Description: Current gain in dB. When parameter is set by xiSetParam the API checks the range. If it is within the range, it tries to find the closest settable value and set it. The actual value can be read by xiGetParam. E.g. Application set gain to 1.3dB, however closest possible value is 1.35dB (analog gain is typically based on sensor PGA registers capabilities). This value is accessible over xiGetParam.

downsampling.Name: downsampling
downsampling.Description: Changes image resolution by binning or skipping. Parameter downsampling_type controls the mapping of sensor pixels to output data.
downsampling.Note1: Downsampling can be changed only before an acquisition is started.
downsampling.Note2: Changing this parameter will flush all images from the buffer queue.

downsampling_type.Name: downsampling_type
downsampling_type.Description: Changes image downsampling type (binning or skipping).
downsampling_type.Note1: Changing this parameter will remove all images from the buffer queue.
downsampling_type.Note2: Changing this parameter will remove all images from the buffer queue.

enum_values.XI_SKIPPING: pixels are skipped - higher frame rate

test_pattern.Name: test_pattern
test_pattern.Description: Selects Test Pattern Type to be generated by the selected Generator Engine.

enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_BLACK: Image is filled with darkest possible image.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_WHITE: Image is filled with brightest possible image.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_GREY_HORIZ_RAMP: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_GREY_VERT_RAMP: Image is filled vertically with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_GREY_HORIZ_RAMP_MOVING: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and moves from left to right.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_GREY_VERT_RAMP_MOVING: Image is filled vertically with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and moves from left to right.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_HORIZ_LINE_MOVING: A moving horizontal line is superimposed on the live image.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_VERT_LINE_MOVING: A moving vertical line is superimposed on the live image.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_COLOR_BAR: Image is filled with stripes of color including White, Black, Red, Green, Blue, Cyan, Magenta and Yellow.
enum_values.XI_TESTPAT_FRAME_COUNTER: A frame counter is superimposed on the live image.

imgdataformat.Name: imgdataformat
imgdataformat.Description: Format of image data returned by function xiGetImage. In order to simplify the control of the camera from application - the xiAPI automatically changes selected camera parameters and Image Processing after setting of XI_PRM_IMAGE_DATA_FORMATIn enumerators table second value in comment bar stands for one pixel data in memory [one_byte].
imgdataformat.Note: Following parameters and Image Processing are controlled automatically by setting of XI_PRM_IMAGE_DATA_FORMAT:
imgdataformat.Note1: Only if camera implementation allows this mode.
imgdataformat.Note2: For XI_RAW16, XI_MONO16 the parameter XI_PRM_IMAGE_DATA_BIT_DEPTHwill be equal toXI_PRM_OUTPUT_DATA_BIT_DEPTH. For other formats theXI_PRM_IMAGE_DATA_BIT_DEPTHwill be 8.
imgdataformat.Note3: Bits alignment: Values are aligned to LSB. XiAPI Image Data Flowis skipped and therefore the Transport format is the most effective data format in terms of CPU and RAM usage.

enum_values.XI_MONO16: 16 bits per pixel. [Intensity LSB] [Intensity MSB] (see Note5,Note6)
enum_values.XI_RAW8: 8 bits per pixel raw data from sensor. [pixel byte] raw data from transport (camera output)
enum_values.XI_RAW16: 16 bits per pixel raw data from sensor. [pixel byte low] [pixel byte high] 16 bits (depacked) raw data
enum_values.XI_FRM_TRANSPORT_DATA: Data from transport layer (e.g. packed). Depends on data on the transport layer (see Note7)
enum_values.XI_RGB48: RGB data format. [Blue low byte][Blue high byte][Green low][Green high][Red low][Red high] (see Note5)
enum_values.XI_RGB64: RGBA data format. [Blue low byte][Blue high byte][Green low][Green high][Red low][Red high][0][0] (Note5)
enum_values.XI_RAW8X2: 8 bits per pixel raw data from sensor(2 components in a row). [ch1 pixel byte] [ch2 pixel byte] 8 bits raw data from 2 channels (e.g. high gain and low gain channels of sCMOS cameras)
enum_values.XI_RAW8X4: 8 bits per pixel raw data from sensor(4 components in a row). [ch1 pixel byte] [ch2 pixel byte] [ch3 pixel byte] [ch4 pixel byte] 8 bits raw data from 4 channels (e.g. sCMOS cameras)
enum_values.XI_RAW16X2: 16 bits per pixel raw data from sensor(2 components in a row). [ch1 pixel byte low] [ch1 pixel byte high] [ch2 pixel byte low] [ch2 pixel byte high] 16 bits (depacked) raw data from 2 channels (e.g. high gain and low gain channels of sCMOS cameras)
enum_values.XI_RAW16X4: 16 bits per pixel raw data from sensor(4 components in a row). [ch1 pixel byte low] [ch1 pixel byte high] [ch2 pixel byte low] [ch2 pixel byte high] [ch3 pixel byte low] [ch3 pixel byte high] [ch4 pixel byte low] [ch4 pixel byte high] 16 bits (depacked) raw data from 4 channels (e.g. sCMOS cameras)
enum_values.XI_RAW32: 32 bits per pixel raw data from sensor in integer format (LSB first). 4 bytes (LSB first) pixel (depacked) raw data
enum_values.XI_RAW32FLOAT: 32 bits per pixel raw data from sensor in single-precision floating point format. 4 bytes per pixel (depacked) raw data

enum_values.XI_SHUTTER_GLOBAL_RESET_RELEASE: Sensor Global Reset Release Shutter(CMOS sensor)

sensor_taps.Name: sensor_taps
sensor_taps.Description: Set/get the number of taps used on sensor.

aeag_roi_offset_x.Name: aeag_roi_offset_x
aeag_roi_offset_x.Description: X offset of the area used for AEAG calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width).

aeag_roi_offset_y.Name: aeag_roi_offset_y
aeag_roi_offset_y.Description: Y offset of the area used for AEAG calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height).

aeag_roi_width.Name: aeag_roi_width
aeag_roi_width.Description: width of the area used for AEAG calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width).

aeag_roi_height.Name: aeag_roi_height
aeag_roi_height.Description: height of the area used for AEAG calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_AEAG_ROI_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height).

bpc_list_selector.Name: bpc_list_selector
bpc_list_selector.Description: Selector for current sensor defects list used by Sensor Defect Correction. For more information see Sensor Defect Correctionsupport page.

sens_defects_corr_list_content.Name: sens_defects_corr_list_content
sens_defects_corr_list_content.Description: Set/Get current sensor defects list used by Sensor Defect Correction(in specific text format).

bpc.Name: bpc
bpc.Description: Correction of sensor defects. For more information see Sensor Defect Correctionsupport page.

manual_wb.Name: manual_wb
manual_wb.Description: Manual white balance. Takes white balance from square in image center of next image received by xiGetImage. Square have 1/8th of width and height of image. The function expects white sheet of paper exposed to 50% of values (RGB values should be around 128). As result of setting of manual_wb three parameters are changed: "wb_kb", "wb_kg" and "wb_kr". User application can store them and recall when needed to set the white balance back.

wb_roi_offset_x.Name: wb_roi_offset_x
wb_roi_offset_x.Description: X offset of the area used for manual WB calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_WB_ROI_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_WB_ROI_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width).

wb_roi_offset_y.Name: wb_roi_offset_y
wb_roi_offset_y.Description: Y offset of the area used for manual WB calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_WB_ROI_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_WB_ROI_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height).

wb_roi_width.Name: wb_roi_width
wb_roi_width.Description: Width of the area used for manual WB calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_WB_ROI_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_WB_ROI_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width).

wb_roi_height.Name: wb_roi_height
wb_roi_height.Description: Height of the area used for manual WB calculation. The sum of XI_PRM_WB_ROI_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_WB_ROI_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height).

width.Name: width
width.Description: If camera runs in single region mode this parameter represents width of the image provided by the device (in pixels). The sum of XI_PRM_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width). Number must be divisible by the minimum increment which can be read out using the api parameter modifierXI_PRM_INFO_INCREMENT. If camera runs in multiple region mode (XI_PRM_REGION_SELECTOR) this parameter is width of region currently selected (in pixels).

height.Name: height
height.Description: If camera runs in single region mode this parameter represents the height of the image provided by the device (in pixels). The sum of XI_PRM_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height). Number must be divisible by the minimum increment which can be read out using the api parameter modifierXI_PRM_INFO_INCREMENT. If camera runs in multiple region mode () this parameter is height of region currently selected.
height.Note1: Changing of this parameter will remove all images from buffer queue.
height.Note2: In case of using small ROI in combination with Fresco FL1100 controller, please read this article.

offsetX.Name: offsetX
offsetX.Description: Horizontal offset from the origin to the area of interest (in pixels). The sum of XI_PRM_OFFSET_XandXI_PRM_WIDTHmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(width). Number must be divisible by the minimum increment which can be read out using the api parameter modifierXI_PRM_INFO_INCREMENT.
offsetX.Note: Changing of this parameter will remove all images from buffer queue.

offsetY.Name: offsetY
offsetY.Description: Vertical offset from the origin to the area of interest (in pixels).The sum of XI_PRM_OFFSET_YandXI_PRM_HEIGHTmust be equal or lower than the image resolution(height). Number must be divisible by the minimum increment which can be read out using the api parameter modifierXI_PRM_INFO_INCREMENT.
offsetY.Note: Changing of this parameter will remove all images from buffer queue.

region_selector.Name: region_selector
region_selector.Description: Selects Region in Multiple ROI. Parameters:XI_PRM_WIDTH,XI_PRM_HEIGHT,XI_PRM_OFFSET_X,XI_PRM_OFFSET_Y,XI_PRM_REGION_MODEare related to the particular region.
region_selector.Note1: Width and offset_x could be changed only for Region 0.
region_selector.Note2: Regions has to be in order from top to bottom. Region N has to start after Region N-1 ends.

region_mode.Name: region_mode
region_mode.Description: Activates/deactivates Region selected by Region Selector in Multiple ROI
region_mode.Note: Region 0 is always activated, it is not possible to deactivate it.

horizontal_flip.Name: horizontal_flip
horizontal_flip.Description: Activates horizontal flip if available in camera.

vertical_flip.Name: vertical_flip
vertical_flip.Description: Activates vertical flip if available in camera.

ffc.Name: ffc
ffc.Description: Image flat field correction.( XI_PRM_NEW_PROCESS_CHAIN_ENABLEmust be XI_ON). For more information seeFlat Field Correctionsupport page.

ffc_flat_field_file_name.Name: ffc_flat_field_file_name
ffc_flat_field_file_name.Description: Set name of file of image flat field to be applied for FFC processor(in tiff format). ( XI_PRM_NEW_PROCESS_CHAIN_ENABLEmust be XI_ON). For more information seeFlat Field Correctionsupport page.
ffc_flat_field_file_name.Note: Use the same image file for this parameter as for XI_PRM_FFC_DARK_FIELD_FILE_NAME for dark-field correction only. Processing will subtract the dark image only while using the unity (1.00) gain for correction.

ffc_dark_field_file_name.Name: ffc_dark_field_file_name
ffc_dark_field_file_name.Description: Selects which binning engine is controlled by the BinningHorizontal and BinningVertical features.

enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_SENSOR: parameters for image sensor binning are selected
enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_DEVICE_FPGA: parameters for device (camera) FPGA decimation are selected
enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_HOST_CPU: parameters for Host CPU binning are selected

ffc_dark_field_file_name.Note: xiAPI allows to set different combinations of binning and decimation parameters.

binning_selector.Name: binning_selector
binning_selector.Description: Selects which binning engine is controlled by the BinningHorizontal and BinningVertical features.

enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_SENSOR: parameters for image sensor binning are selected
enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_DEVICE_FPGA: parameters for device (camera) FPGA decimation are selected
enum_values.XI_BIN_SELECT_HOST_CPU: parameters for Host CPU binning are selected

binning_vertical_mode.Name: binning_vertical_mode
binning_vertical_mode.Description: Sets the mode used to combine horizontal photo-sensitive cells together when BinningVertical is used.

enum_values.XI_BIN_MODE_SUM: The response from the combined pixels will be added, resulting in increased sensitivity.
enum_values.XI_BIN_MODE_AVERAGE: The response from the combined pixels will be averaged, resulting in increased signal/noise ratio.

binning_vertical.Name: binning_vertical
binning_vertical.Description: Number of vertical photo-sensitive cells to combine together. This reduces the vertical resolution (height) of the image.
binning_vertical.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

binning_horizontal_mode.Name: binning_horizontal_mode
binning_horizontal_mode.Description: Sets the mode to use to combine horizontal photo-sensitive cells together when BinningHorizontal is used.

enum_values.XI_BIN_MODE_SUM: The response from the combined pixels will be added, resulting in increased sensitivity.
enum_values.XI_BIN_MODE_AVERAGE: The response from the combined pixels will be averaged, resulting in increased signal/noise ratio.

binning_horizontal.Name: binning_horizontal
binning_horizontal.Description: Number of horizontal photo-sensitive cells to combine together. This reduces the horizontal resolution (width) of the image.
binning_horizontal.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

binning_horizontal_pattern.Name: binning_horizontal_pattern
binning_horizontal_pattern.Description: Defines number of horizontal photo-sensitive cells to combine.
binning_horizontal_pattern.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

enum_values.XI_BIN_BAYER: Bayer pattern is preserved during pixel combining

binning_vertical_pattern.Name: binning_vertical_pattern
binning_vertical_pattern.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

enum_values.XI_BIN_BAYER: Bayer pattern is preserved during pixel combining

enum_values.XI_DEC_SELECT_SENSOR: parameters for image sensor decimation are selected
enum_values.XI_DEC_SELECT_DEVICE_FPGA: parameters for device (camera) FPGA decimation are selected
enum_values.XI_DEC_SELECT_HOST_CPU: parameters for Host CPU decimation are selected

decimation_vertical.Name: decimation_vertical
decimation_vertical.Description: Vertical sub-sampling of the image. This reduces the vertical resolution (height) of the image by the specified vertical decimation factor.
decimation_vertical.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

decimation_horizontal.Name: decimation_horizontal
decimation_horizontal.Description: Horizontal sub-sampling of the image. This reduces the horizontal resolution (width) of the image by the specified horizontal decimation factor.
decimation_horizontal.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

decimation_horizontal_pattern.Name: decimation_horizontal_pattern
decimation_horizontal_pattern.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

enum_values.XI_DEC_BAYER: Bayer pattern is preserved during pixel decimation

decimation_vertical_pattern.Name: decimation_vertical_pattern
decimation_vertical_pattern.Note: Setting this parameter may automatically change other Binning/Decimation parameters in order to achieve a valid combination.

enum_values.XI_DEC_BAYER: Bayer pattern is preserved during pixel decimation

exp_priority.Name: exp_priority
exp_priority.Description: Exposure priority for Auto Exposure / Auto Gain function.

ag_max_limit.Name: ag_max_limit
ag_max_limit.Description: Maximum limit of gain in AEAG procedure.

ae_max_limit.Name: ae_max_limit
ae_max_limit.Description: Maximum limit of exposure (in uSec) in AEAG procedure.

aeag_level.Name: aeag_level
aeag_level.Description: Average intensity of output signal AEAG should achieve(in %).

limit_bandwidth.Name: limit_bandwidth
limit_bandwidth.Description: Camera acquisition data-rate Limit on transport layer in Megabits (1000000) per second. API controls the camera clock or increases the line period by 1 in order to achieve the closest data-rate as the Limit value set, ensuring the data-rate is below the Limit. This parameter can be used to decrease data-rate e.g. when more cameras are connected to same interface to share same channel. In order to activate the limit - application should set also XI_PRM_LIMIT_BANDWIDTH_MODE= XI_ON, see example below.
limit_bandwidth.Note: Controlling method (clock or line period) depends on the camera model.
limit_bandwidth.Example: See more at our application note about Multiple Cameras Setup.

limit_bandwidth_mode.Name: limit_bandwidth_mode
limit_bandwidth_mode.Description: Controls if the XI_PRM_LIMIT_BANDWIDTHis active. When disabled, lower level specific features are expected to control the throughput. When enabled,XI_PRM_LIMIT_BANDWIDTHcontrols the overall throughput.
limit_bandwidth_mode.Note: This parameter is not supported on MQ, MU, MD, MR camera families.

sensor_bit_depth.Name: sensor_bit_depth
sensor_bit_depth.Description: Returns the bit depth of the pixel data received from sensor.
sensor_bit_depth.Note: Read more at XiAPI Image Data Flow.

output_bit_depth.Name: output_bit_depth
output_bit_depth.Description: The bit depth of the output data from camera (=transport layer).
output_bit_depth.Note: Read more at XiAPI Image Data Flow.

image_data_bit_depth.Name: image_data_bit_depth
image_data_bit_depth.Description: The bit depth of the pixel data returned by function xiGetImage. If MONO16 or RAW16 image formats are used this parameter defines the alignment of the data on the xiGetImage.

output_bit_packing.Name: output_bit_packing
output_bit_packing.Description: This feature enables bit packing on transport data layer, thus increasing the maximum frame rate when data with 10 or 12 bits per pixel is transported. For more info please see Transport Data Packingfeature description.
output_bit_packing.Note: Read more at XiAPI Image Data Flow.

output_bit_packing_type.Name: output_bit_packing_type
output_bit_packing_type.Description: This feature chooses output data packing type(ximea grouping 10g160, 12g192, 14g224), PFNC packing 10p, 12p...). For more info please see Transport Data Packingfeature description.

iscooled.Name: iscooled
iscooled.Description: Returns 1 for cameras that support cooling.

cooling.Name: cooling
cooling.Description: Set camera cooling control. Replaced by XI_PRM_TEMP_CONTROL_MODE

enum_values.XI_TEMP_CTRL_MODE_OFF: Controlling of elements (TEC/Peltier, Fans) is turned off
enum_values.XI_TEMP_CTRL_MODE_AUTO: Controlling of elements is performed automatically by API or camera in order to reach parameter TARGET_TEMP.
enum_values.XI_TEMP_CTRL_MODE_MANUAL: Controlling of elements is done manually by application.

target_temp.Name: target_temp
target_temp.Description: Set target temperature for automatic temperature control.

temp.Name: temp
temp.Description: Selected thermometer reading in degree Celsius. Thermometer can be selected by XI_PRM_TEMP_SELECTOR.

device_temperature_ctrl_mode.Name: device_temperature_ctrl_mode
device_temperature_ctrl_mode.Description: Temperature reading of thermometer chip. Sensor is located on the PCB close to imaging sensor. Units: degrees of Celsius.
device_temperature_ctrl_mode.Note: On some camera models, when some component (e.g. housing) reaches critical temperature, the mode is changed to XI_TEMP_CTRL_MODE_OFF automatically by camera and this mode remains off. It can be re-enabled by setting mode to XI_TEMP_CTRL_MODE_AUTO. By getting XI_PRM_TEMP_CONTROL_MODE, application can get the information, about current state. XI_PRM_CHIP_TEMP or "chip_temp"¶

chip_temp.Name: chip_temp
chip_temp.Description: Temperature reading of thermometer chip. Sensor is located on the PCB close to imaging sensor. Units: degrees of Celsius.

enum_values.XI_TEMP_ELEM_TEC1: TEC1 = TEC/Peltier that is closest to the image sensor
enum_values.XI_TEMP_ELEM_TEC2: TEC2 = TEC/Peltier location depends on camera model
enum_values.XI_TEMP_ELEM_FAN1: Temperature element fan current or rotation (FAN1 = Fan)
enum_values.XI_TEMP_ELEM_FAN1_THRS_TEMP: Temperature element fan start rotation threshold temperature

device_temperature_element_val.Name: device_temperature_element_val
device_temperature_element_val.Description: Temperature element value in percents of full control range.

cms.Name: cms
cms.Note: This feature is in Beta stage.

enum_values.XI_CMS_EN_FAST: enables fast color management (high RAM usage)

cms_intent.Name: cms_intent
cms_intent.Description: Defines rendering intents. See more at our support page CMS INTENT.
cms_intent.Note1: This feature is in Beta stage.

apply_cms.Name: apply_cms
apply_cms.Description: If set to XI_ON applies CMS profile to xiGetImage.

input_cms_profile.Name: input_cms_profile
input_cms_profile.Description: Filename of the input cms profile (e.g. input.icc)

output_cms_profile.Name: output_cms_profile
output_cms_profile.Description: Filename of the output cms profile (e.g. output.icc)

cfa.Name: cfa
cfa.Description: Returns color filter array type of RAW data.

enum_values.XI_CFA_NONE: Result pixels have no filters applied in this format

gammaY.Name: gammaY
gammaY.Description: Luminosity gamma.Lowering the value increases correction.

sharpness.Name: sharpness
sharpness.Description: Sharpness Strength. Increasing the value results in sharper image.
sharpness.Note: Works also for XI_MONO* formats, but only for color cameras.

ccMTX00.Name: ccMTX00
ccMTX00.Description: Color Correction Matrix element [0][0].Correction Matrix elements:

ccMTXnorm.Name: ccMTXnorm
ccMTXnorm.Description: Activates normalization of color correction matrix.

trigger_source.Name: trigger_source
trigger_source.Note: To set input as external trigger, XI_PRM_GPI_MODEof selected input should be set to XI_GPI_TRIGGER. See example atXI_PRM_GPI_MODE.

enum_values.XI_TRG_OFF: Capture of next image is automatically started after previous.
enum_values.XI_TRG_EDGE_RISING: Capture is started on rising edge of selected input.
enum_values.XI_TRG_EDGE_FALLING: Capture is started on falling edge of selected input
enum_values.XI_TRG_SOFTWARE: Capture is started with software trigger.
enum_values.XI_TRG_LEVEL_HIGH: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is high.
enum_values.XI_TRG_LEVEL_LOW: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is low.

trigger_source.Example: For more examples see xiAPI Camera Trigger and Synchronization Signals.

trigger_software.Name: trigger_software
trigger_software.Description: Generates an internal trigger. XI_PRM_TRG_SOURCEhas to be set to XI_TRG_SOFTWARE.
trigger_software.Note: Some models ( xiMU- MU9 andxiQ) return error code if sensor is not ready to start exposure of next image. Other cameras return XI_OK even if sensor is not ready to start exposure.

trigger_selector.Name: trigger_selector
trigger_selector.Description: This parameter selects the type of trigger. For more information about enumerator XI_TRG_SEL_EXPOSURE_ACTIVE please refer to our Exposure Defined by Trigger Pulse Lengthsupport page. Frame Burst Modessupport page. Multiple exposures in one framesupport page.

enum_values.XI_TRG_SEL_FRAME_START: Trigger starts the capture of one frame
enum_values.XI_TRG_SEL_EXPOSURE_ACTIVE: Trigger controls the start and length of the exposure.

trigger_overlap.Name: trigger_overlap

acq_buffer_size.Description: Defines the size of the acquisition buffer in bytes(see Image below). This is a circle buffer which contains image data from sensor. This parameter can be set only when acquisition is stopped.
acq_buffer_size.Note1: If the processing of this image takes more time than these 7seconds, the image data will be automatically overwritten with new image data due to the circular character of the buffer.
acq_buffer_size.Note2: The maximal value for this parameter is 2147483647 because it uses the signed integer.

acq_transport_buffer_size.Name: acq_transport_buffer_size
acq_transport_buffer_size.Description: Size of one transport buffer in bytes (only valid for MQ,MD camera families). Frame/Field can contain multiple transport buffers. To decrease CPU load and increase system performance on committing transport buffers to kernel driver, transport buffer size has to be as high as possible. However in case of small Frame/Field size and high framerates it is necessary to decrease transport buffer size and increase queue of Frame/Field buffers ( XI_PRM_BUFFERS_QUEUE_SIZE). Check outHow to optimize software performance on high frame ratesfor more info.
acq_transport_buffer_size.Note: Whole range minimum to maximum is not guaranteed on all tested configurations. Please be aware of possible issues on some controllers.
acq_transport_buffer_size.Example: Application set transport buffer size to 128KiB for small (80KB images)

acq_transport_packet_size.Name: acq_transport_packet_size

buffers_queue_size.Name: buffers_queue_size
buffers_queue_size.Description: XI_PRM_BUFFERS_QUEUE_SIZE- 1 is the maximum number of images which can be stored in the buffers queue.
buffers_queue_size.Example: Application sets queue size to 7Sensor acquires images at 10 frames/second. It means new image is acquired every 100ms, therefore queue can contain up to 6 images acquired during 600ms (=6*100ms) time span.Application needs typically 40ms for processing of an imageIf it takes 400ms for the application to process one of the images (e.g. saving it to a server) the subsequent 4 frames are still available since they are stored in the queue (images 17-19 on the below figure).Illustration of normal status when application is processing one frame longerIf it takes 1000ms for the application to process one of the images, the buffer queue will fill up and some images will be skipped (images 16-20 on the below figure). The user can check for such situation by checking the image sequence number (nframe of XI_IMG structure) of each image.Illustration of state when application gets late. Longer than queue. XI_PRM_BUFFER_POLICYmust be set to XI_BP_SAFE. In this case API copies the image to a user/API allocated memory where it can be accessed without the risk of being overwritten. This copying however takes extra CPU time.

device_reset.Description: Resets the camera firmware. From the functional view, it is the same as disconnection and connection of the camera.It is typically followed by an enumeration of the operating system which might take some time (e.g. 10 seconds). Application shall wait some time after the reset and then use xiGetNumberDevices in order to enumerate the camera again. It should be used on the device with the stopped acquisition. After re-enumeration closing of the old device to release its handler is recommended. A new handler should be used for further image acquisition.

sensor_mode.Name: sensor_mode
sensor_mode.Description: Current sensor mode. Allows to select sensor mode by one integer. Setting of this parameter affects: image dimensions and downsampling.

hdr.Name: hdr
hdr.Description: Enable High Dynamic Range sensor feature.
hdr.Note1: enables HDR mode for certain type of sensors. For more information see HDR modesupport page.

hdr_kneepoint_count.Name: hdr_kneepoint_count
hdr_kneepoint_count.Note1: Defines the number of kneepoints in the Piecewise Linear Response (PWLR) curve.
hdr_kneepoint_count.Note2: In case of one kneepoint, the kneepoint is defined by parameters (T2,SL2). In case of two kneepoints define both (T1,SL1), (T2,SL2).

hdr_t1.Name: hdr_t1
hdr_t1.Description: Exposure time (T1) of 1st kneepoint in % of XI_PRM_EXPOSURE

hdr_t2.Name: hdr_t2
hdr_t2.Description: Exposure time (T2) of 2nd kneepoint in % of

hdr_kneepoint1.Name: hdr_kneepoint1
hdr_kneepoint1.Description: Saturation level (SL1) of 1st kneepoint in % of sensor saturation.

hdr_kneepoint2.Name: hdr_kneepoint2
hdr_kneepoint2.Description: Saturation level (SL2) of 2nd kneepoint in % of sensor saturation.

image_black_level.Name: image_black_level
image_black_level.Description: Black level is calculated level (in pixel counts) that should reflect the value of pixels without light. It should be the same as XI_IMG.black_level from last image get using xiGetImage. Setting of this parameter does not affect the data from sensor or API when camera is connected. It can be used for setting black level only for Offline Processing.

image_area.Name: image_area
image_area.Description: Defines image area of sensor as output.

enum_values.XI_IMAGE_AREA_ACTIVE: All light sensitive pixels suggested by image vendor.
enum_values.XI_IMAGE_AREA_ACTIVE_AND_MASKED: All Active pixels plus masked pixels surrounding the Active area.

dual_adc_gain_ratio.Name: dual_adc_gain_ratio
dual_adc_gain_ratio.Description: Sets DualADC Gain Ratio in dB

version_selector.Name: version_selector
version_selector.Description: Selects module/unit, which version we get.

drv_version.Name: drv_version
drv_version.Description: Returns the version of the current device driver.

version_mcu1.Name: version_mcu1
version_mcu1.Description: Returns the version of the current MCU1 firmware.

version_mcu2.Name: version_mcu2
version_mcu2.Description: Returns the version of the current MCU2 firmware.

version_mcu3.Name: version_mcu3
version_mcu3.Description: Returns the version of the current MCU3 firmware.

version_fpga1.Name: version_fpga1
version_fpga1.Description: Returns version of FPGA firmware currently running.

hw_revision.Name: hw_revision
hw_revision.Description: Returns the hardware revision number of the camera.

debug_level.Name: debug_level
debug_level.Description: Setting the API debug level allows to select amount of messages stored to debug output.

enum_values.XI_DL_TRACE: Prints errors, warnings and important informations

debug_level.Note1: Prints same as XI_DL_TRACE plus locking of resources.
debug_level.Note2: In Windows use DebugView to view the current messages.
debug_level.Note3: In Linux the messages are printed to stderr

auto_bandwidth_calculation.Name: auto_bandwidth_calculation
auto_bandwidth_calculation.Description: Setting this parameter the application can control API behavior. Setting to XI_OFF - API will skip auto bandwidth measurement and calculation before opening the camera (xiOpenDevice), resulting in reducing the time to open a camera. Setting to XI_ON the measurement is enabled (default).
auto_bandwidth_calculation.Note1: It is important to set this parameter to XI_OFF in case when multiple cameras are connected to one hub with enabled acquisition and new camera should be opened - to not affect overall streaming by auto bandwidth measurement.
auto_bandwidth_calculation.Note2: When set to value XI_OFF, the time required to open a camera (xiOpenDevice) is reduced.

new_process_chain_enable.Name: new_process_chain_enable
new_process_chain_enable.Description: Setting this parameter the application can control API behavior. When set to XI_OFF - API will use original processing in image pipe for cameras families MU, MQ, MD. Setting to XI_ON - API will use newer processing type.
new_process_chain_enable.Note: There are some differences between processing so the switching may be done with caution. For older implementation we advise to stick to original processing. Only if some features require the newer processing it might be enabled. Switching may be done before xiOpenDevice.

proc_num_threads.Name: proc_num_threads
proc_num_threads.Description: Number of threads per image processor. An application can change this number in order to optimize performance or decrease number of threads to save resources.
proc_num_threads.Note: Some of XIMEA cameras contain Flash File System. It allows to store/read small customer file in each camera. For more information visit our knowledge base article How to work with FFS.

read_file_ffs.Name: read_file_ffs
read_file_ffs.Description: File data to be read from camera flash file system.

write_file_ffs.Name: write_file_ffs
write_file_ffs.Description: File data to be written to camera flash file system.

ffs_file_name.Name: ffs_file_name
ffs_file_name.Description: Name of file to be written/read from camera FFS.
ffs_file_name.Note: On MX,MC,CB,MT cameras family, there is limited set of filenames. User's application can use filenames: User1, User2, User3 to store some application specific data.

ffs_file_size.Name: ffs_file_size
ffs_file_size.Description: Size of a file specified with parameter XI_PRM_FFS_FILE_IDin bytes.

free_ffs_size.Description: Size of free camera flash file system space in bytes.

used_ffs_size.Name: used_ffs_size
used_ffs_size.Description: Size of used camera flash file system space in bytes.

ffs_access_key.Name: ffs_access_key
ffs_access_key.Description: Setting of the key enables file operations on some cameras. It is required to set before usage of XI_PRM_WRITE_FILE_FFS.

xiapi_context_list.Name: xiapi_context_list
xiapi_context_list.Description: API Context contains the text representation of current settings for offline image processing. It can be gotten while acquisition to store the context. Respectively, it can be set while offline processing - to restore the context.
xiapi_context_list.Note: Some of XIMEA cameras have sensors with specific features.

sensor_feature_selector.Name: sensor_feature_selector
sensor_feature_selector.Description: Selects the current feature which is accessible by XI_PRM_SENSOR_FEATURE_VALUE. See more at our support page,SENSOR FEATURE SELECTOR.

enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_ZEROROT_ENABLE: Sensor Zero ROT enable for ONSEMI PYTHON family. For camera model:MQ013xG-ON (on/off)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_BLACK_LEVEL_CLAMP: Black level offset clamping (value). for Camera model:MD
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_MD_FPGA_DIGITAL_GAIN_D: Disable digital component of gain for MD family (1=disabled/0=enabled)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_ACQUISITION_RUNNING: Sensor acquisition is running status (0/1). Could be stopped by setting of 0. For camera model:CB,MC,MX,MT
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_TIMING_MODE: Sensor timing mode (value depends on sensor)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_PARALLEL_ADC: When ON, all pixels are readout by 2-parallel ADC reducing the maximal framerate (to a half) and improving the image quality. This is available only on some cameras. (on/off)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_BLACK_LEVEL_OFFSET_RAW: Sensor specific register raw black level offset (value)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_HIGH_CONVERSION_GAIN: Serves as additional analog gain of 9.7 dB in pixels before conversion, essentially improving the image quality. This is available only on some cameras. (on/off)
enum_values.XI_SENSOR_FEATURE_DUAL_TRG_EXP_ZONE_DIVI: Sensor Dual Trigger Exposure Zone Divider Position
